recognize_zh: 高倍下見大小不一的中大型非典型淋巴樣細胞，核形不規則、核膜清楚、染色質空泡狀並有明顯核仁，細胞質淡染，其間夾雜小淋巴球與深染的凋亡／核分裂細胞，符合 PTCL, NOS 的細胞學。
features: Irregular, notched to polygonal vesicular nuclei with distinct nuclear membranes
Moderate pale amphophilic to clear cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes and scattered dark mitotic/apoptotic cells in fibrillary eosinophilic stroma
describe_en: High-power section shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium-to-large pleomorphic lymphoid cells with irregular, notched vesicular nuclei, distinct nuclear membranes, prominent nucleoli, and moderate pale to clear cytoplasm. Small lymphocytes and scattered hyperchromatic mitotic or apoptotic cells are admixed within a fibrillary eosinophilic stroma. No specific architectural features are appreciated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, provided a T-cell phenotype is confirmed and more specific entities (AITL/nodal TFH lymphoma, ALCL) are excluded by immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are more monomorphic and CD20/PAX5 positive, whereas PTCL cells are CD3+ with frequent loss of CD5 or CD7.
ALCL shows hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and strong, uniform membranous and Golgi CD30 expression.
AITL shows prominent HEV proliferation, FDC expansion and TFH marker expression (PD1, CXCL13, ICOS, BCL6).
